value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver: partly sunny, high around 65, a good bit cooler than today's 80. Wind north-northeast at 6 to 10 mph, gusts up to 17 mph. Rain and showers could move in Tuesday evening, with about a 30% chance after 3 p.m., and the chance climbs overnight. Lows Tuesday night in the low 40s and 30s.
